title: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say

reports.title: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say

summary:
On Aug. 3 in Cypress, Texas, Harris County sheriff's deputies mistook two 19 year old men, Anthony and Julian, for car thieves. Deputies surrounded Anthony's Camaro with at least five patrol cars and a helicopter, pointed guns, handcuffed them, and one deputy reportedly threatened to shoot Julian. The men were returning from a gas station. Deputies thought the car was a stolen Camaro linked to aggravated robberies after license plate cameras picked up plates, but neither a deputy nor helicopter could read the plates.

After handcuffing them, deputies realized it was the wrong car and explained they were looking for a stolen vehicle. Anthony's mother plans to hire an attorney. The sheriff's office says supervisors will review body worn cameras to check whether procedures were followed. The men were given information on filing a formal complaint with internal affairs, and both plan to do so.
title_en: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say
